phrase: I didn't know it was me
quote: I was looking down at the me in the bed and I didn't know it was me. And I thought, wow, I hope she's okay.

phrase: I didn't even realize at first that it was me
quote: When I was leaving my body I saw this body, this thing — I didn't even realize at first that it was me.

phrase: I didn't think for a second that that was me
quote: It almost didn't look human. I didn't think for a second that that was me, because me was up here watching.

phrase: that's me, but it wasn't me
quote: That's me. But it wasn't me. There was my body, that skin suit that I had been wearing around life.

phrase: it's not me, it's not me
quote: I looked down at my body. I kind of feel sorry for the body, it looks kind of bad, but it doesn't bother me. It's not me, it's not me.
I was looking at my body but without any feelings toward it. It was just like an empty box. It's not me.

phrase: I didn't see me there anymore
quote: I knew that that was me, but I didn't see me there anymore. My soul was no longer a part of that shell of a body.

phrase: I saw a body suspended in the water
quote: I saw a body suspended in the water, and incredibly at that moment I knew that that was my body.

phrase: so small and helpless and lifeless
quote: I was aware of my body lying there in that hospital bed, but my body looked so small and helpless and lifeless compared to how I was feeling.
